bells.name: Terce
bells.text: PLACEHOLDER: Morning. The day's work has started without you.

bells.name: Sext
bells.text: PLACEHOLDER: Noon. The sun, such as it is.

bells.name: Vespers
bells.text: PLACEHOLDER: Dusk. The light is going.

bells.name: Compline
bells.text: PLACEHOLDER: Night. Somewhere to sleep, or not.

blooded.title: Blooded
blooded.description: Hidden: you have killed in the crown's service.

boar-known.title: Knows the Boar
boar-known.description: Hidden: 1 once you have found the Boar; it is then one of the town's places.

brawn.title: Brawn
brawn.description: Muscle, and the will to use it.

company-loyalty.title: The ranks
company-loyalty.description: Hidden: how the men of the company feel about you (arc brief: levy/company-loyalty, 0-5).

confessed.title: Confessed
confessed.description: Hidden: you told the chaplain what you did. Unpaid: nothing reads it yet.

crowns-favour.title: Crown's Favour
crowns-favour.description: How well the crown thinks of you, should this ever end.

deserter.title: Deserter
deserter.description: Hidden: you ran, and the crown hunts you for it.

desire.title: Desire
desire.description: PLACEHOLDER: The body's other hunger. It grows by the day.

harl.title: Sergeant Harl
harl.description: The man who runs your section of the camp.

levels.9: He'd take a blade for you.

harl-away.title: Sergeant Harl
harl-away.description: A timer. Days until Harl is back in camp.

levels.2: PLACEHOLDER: Gone to the city. A day or two.

hunger.title: Hunger
hunger.description: An empty belly, and getting emptier.

kings-levy.title: The King's Levy
kings-levy.description: How deep into the crown's war you are.

levels.5: On the road to the front.
levels.7: Given an order that will cost you something.

levy-notice.title: The pressgang
levy-notice.description: A timer: days until the pressgang comes looking. Set when you hide from the levy.

levels.1: PLACEHOLDER: They'll come for you tomorrow.
levels.2: PLACEHOLDER: Word is they're still asking after you.

levy-path.title: Levy path
levy-path.description: Hidden: how you entered the levy. 1 volunteer, 2 pressed, 3 irregular.

lives.title: Lives
lives.description: Hidden: how many times you have died and gone on. Unpaid in this demo slice.

mercy-at-the-ford.title: Mercy at the Ford
mercy-at-the-ford.description: Hidden: you warned a village the company meant to burn.

provisions.title: Provisions
provisions.description: Food enough for the road, or not.

sent-another.title: Sent another
sent-another.description: Hidden: someone went to the levy in your place. Unpaid: no card reads this yet.

sleepiness.title: Sleepiness
sleepiness.description: How long you have been awake. It grows with everything you do; sleep clears it.

levels.5: PLACEHOLDER: Tired. A bed would be welcome.

slept-well.title: Slept well
slept-well.description: Hidden: how you slept last night: 0 rough, 1 fair, 2 good. Sleep cards read it.

standing.title: Standing in the Company
standing.description: What the ranks think of you.
standing.changeUp: The company's opinion of you rises.
standing.changeDown: The company's opinion of you falls.

stayed-up.title: Stayed up
stayed-up.description: Hidden: 1 when you chose to stay up tonight. Reset at dawn.

the-march.title: The March
the-march.description: How far the column has come on the road to the front.

levels.1: PLACEHOLDER: The camp is still in sight behind you.
levels.2: PLACEHOLDER: Hills you have never seen.
levels.4: PLACEHOLDER: The river country. All the talk is of the ford.
levels.5: PLACEHOLDER: Within a morning of the ford.

wounds.title: Wounds
wounds.description: Cuts, breaks, and the pain of them.

a-bed-for-the-night.title: A Bed for the Night
a-bed-for-the-night.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Somewhere to lay your head. It is there when you are tired, or when night falls. The day ends when you lie down.

branches.title: The Boar's loft
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Two coins for a straw mattress under the Boar's rafters, and a door that bars.

success.title: A real bed
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You sleep like the dead, and wake like the living.

branches.title: A corner of the stable
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: One coin, and the ostler looks the other way.

success.title: Straw and horses
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The horses are warm, and they don't talk.

branches.title: A doorway out of the wind
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Free, and worth every penny.

success.title: Cold stone
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You sleep in snatches, one hand on your purse.

a-cutpurse.title: A Cutpurse
a-cutpurse.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A hand at your belt in the crowd, quick as a bird.

branches.title: Grab the wrist
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You feel it before you see it.

success.title: Caught
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: A thin boy, all eyes. You let him go. He will remember your face.

failure.title: Gone
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: By the time you turn, there is only the crowd, and your purse is lighter.

a-fight-in-the-lines.title: A Fight in the Lines
a-fight-in-the-lines.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Two men from your tent, rolling in the mud over a debt.

branches.title: Pull them apart
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Before a sergeant sees.

success.title: Peace, for now
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: They shake hands. Both of them owe you now.

failure.title: Now it is three of you
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: Someone hits you. You are not sure who. The sergeant arrives anyway.

branches.title: Watch
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Not your fight.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: It ends the way these things end. You remember who won.

a-man-on-the-wagon.title: A Man on the Wagon
a-man-on-the-wagon.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The sick wagon has filled up since the camp. A man from your own section is on it now, grey in the face, asking for water.

branches.title: Walk beside the wagon
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Drop back and walk with the wagon for a while.

success.title: Water and a little bread
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You share what you have. He does not thank you; he does not have the breath.

branches.title: Keep your distance
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Whatever he has, you do not want it.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You keep your eyes on the road ahead.

a-quiet-night.title: A Quiet Night
a-quiet-night.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Nothing wakes you. For once, nothing at all.

branches.title: Wake
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Another day.

success.title: Morning
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You get up.

a-thief-in-the-night.title: A Thief in the Night
a-thief-in-the-night.intro: PLACEHOLDER: You sleep rough, and rough sleepers get robbed.

branches.title: Count what's left
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your purse strings are cut clean.

success.title: Lighter
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Someone ate well on your coin last night.

a-voice-in-the-dark.title: A Voice in the Dark
a-voice-in-the-dark.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The man in the next bedroll is talking, low, to nobody. Or to you.

branches.title: Answer it
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You whisper back.

success.title: Two men awake
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: He doesn't say much. He remembers that you listened.

branches.title: Pretend to sleep
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Some things are better not heard.

success.title: The voice stops
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Eventually he stops. Eventually you sleep.

ash.title: Ash
ash.intro: {if [q:mercy-at-the-ford]==1}PLACEHOLDER: Word comes back along the column that the village was empty by the time the torches went in. Empty houses, empty grain stores, no bodies. Someone got there first. You keep your face still.{else}{if [q:blooded]==1}PLACEHOLDER: You've killed men before this morning. Burning a village down around its own hearths feels like a different thing entirely, and you can't say why.{else}PLACEHOLDER: The village burns quietly through the night. By morning it's just another grey smear on the horizon, and the column eats well for once.{/if}{/if}

branches.title: Move on
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: There's nothing to do here now but keep walking.

success.title: What's left
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The company falls back in and moves on, the way it always does.

blisters.title: Blisters
blisters.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The new boots the quartermaster gave you have opened your heels by noon. Half the column is limping.

branches.title: Bind your feet
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Fall out for a moment, and do it properly.

success.title: Rags and grease
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You bind them tight and catch the column up. It helps, a little.

branches.title: March on them
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Say nothing. Keep your place in the line.

success.title: The pain goes somewhere else
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You do not limp. The men around you notice.

failure.title: Every step
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: By evening your boots are full of blood.

boot-inspection.title: Boot Inspection
boot-inspection.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The corporal walks the line, looking at feet.

branches.title: Stand straight and hope
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your boots have seen better days. So has he.

success.title: He walks past
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: He grunts, and moves on.

failure.title: He stops
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: Extra drill, and the whole line knows why.

camp-talk.title: Camp Talk
camp-talk.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Men with nothing to do talk about everything.

branches.title: Grumbling about rations
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The pork is older than the youngest recruit.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Everyone has a worse story. You listen to all of them.

branches.title: Gossip about the officers
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Who owes whom, who drinks, who will get you killed.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You learn which officers to stand behind, and which to avoid.

branches.title: Talk of home
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Villages, wives, a dog someone misses more than the wife.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Nobody says what they are afraid of. They talk about home instead.

carry-letters.title: Carrying Letters
carry-letters.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A clerk with more letters than legs.

branches.title: Run them across town
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Names, streets, and people who do not want to be found.

success.title: Every door, the right door
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You learn the town street by street, and the clerk pays well.

failure.title: One went astray
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: One letter comes back to the clerk unopened. He docks you for it.

cold-ground.title: Cold Ground
cold-ground.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Rain in the night. The ground under the wagon turned to soup.

branches.title: Get up, somehow
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your joints have opinions about this.

success.title: Stiff but whole
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You shake it off.

failure.title: The cold got in
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: Something in your chest rattles now.

collapse.title: You Collapse
collapse.intro: PLACEHOLDER: You have gone too long without sleep. Your body decides for you.

branches.title: The ground comes up to meet you
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Wherever you are, that's where you sleep.

success.title: Out like a snuffed candle
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You wake with no memory of lying down, and a head full of wool.

corpse-on-the-road.title: A Body in the Ditch
corpse-on-the-road.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The column steps around it. Nobody looks down.

branches.title: Look down
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: {if [q:mercy-at-the-ford] > 0}You wonder if he came from the village you warned.{else}A farmer, by his hands.{/if}

success.title: You look
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You make yourself see him. It will not be the last.

failure.title: You wish you had not
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: You see his face at night for a week.

branches.title: Walk on
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Eyes front, like the rest.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Eyes front.

dice-night.title: Dice Night
dice-night.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Dice come out most nights the company isn't marching. Coin changes hands fast, and not always fairly.

branches.title: Sit in on the dice game
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You've got coin to lose. Might as well lose it on your own terms.

success.title: You clean up
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The dice run hot for you tonight, and the ranks around the fire aren't happy about it.

success.title: A modest win
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You come away a little heavier in the purse than you started.

success.title: You lose your shirt
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The dice turn on you, and keep turning. You walk away lighter and wiser, for tonight at least.

dig-latrines.title: Latrine Detail
dig-latrines.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Someone has to dig them. Today it is you.

branches.title: Dig
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The sergeants notice who digs without complaint.

success.title: A deep enough hole
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Nobody thanks you. Somebody remembers.

dream-of-the-day.title: You Dream
dream-of-the-day.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Sleep turns the day over and shows you the underside.

branches.title: You dream of blows
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Fists, staves, the weight of a spear.

success.title: Your arms remember
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You wake with your hands already closed.

branches.title: You dream of faces
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Everyone you spoke to yesterday, saying something else.

success.title: You remember who lied
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You wake knowing something you didn't.

branches.title: You dream of the dark
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Something in the dark, and you, walking toward it.

success.title: You did not flinch
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You wake steadier than you lay down.

drill-yard.title: The Drill Yard
drill-yard.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Tents in orderly rows, smoke from the cook-fires, the same drills every morning. This corner of the camp belongs to Sergeant Harl, as far as anything here belongs to anyone.{if [q:harl-away] > 0} Harl's tent is empty: [q:harl-away]{/if}

branches.title: Drill with the ranks
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Fall in with the rest and try to keep up.

success.title: You keep pace
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You keep pace, more or less, and it shows.

failure.title: You fall behind
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: You fall out of step and take a boot for it. Lesson learned, the hard way.

branches.title: Mend your kit
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your kit won't mend itself.

success.title: A quiet hour with needle and leather
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: A needle, some thread, and an hour you didn't have to spare.

branches.title: Listen to the old hands talk
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The old hands never tire of telling the same three stories.

success.title: Their stories are all the same shape
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You've heard this one before. You listen anyway.

branches.title: Watch the yard
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: There's always something to learn from watching, if you pay attention.

success.title: You learn the rhythms of the place
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You start to see the shape of how this place actually works.

branches.title: The officers' tent
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The officers' tent is out of bounds for the likes of you. That's exactly why it's worth a look.

success.title: Nobody notices you
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: In and out before anyone notices you were ever there.

failure.title: An officer notices you
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: An officer catches you loitering near the tent flap. You talk your way clear, mostly.

fetch-water.title: Water Detail
fetch-water.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Two buckets, a yoke, and a river that is further than it looks.

branches.title: Carry the water
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Trip after trip, while the cooks shout for more.

success.title: Full buckets
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The cooks feed you first tonight.

failure.title: Half of it on the path
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: You slip on the bank and come back soaked and bruised.

fever.title: Fever
fever.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Your untreated wounds have turned, and somewhere on the road a fever sets in. You can feel it climbing.

branches.title: Fight the fever
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: There's no surgeon out here. Whatever happens next, you'll manage it yourself.

success.title: It breaks
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The fever breaks in the night, and you wake up soaked in sweat but clear-headed.

failure.title: It doesn't break
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: The fever doesn't break. It gets worse, and drags whatever strength you had left down with it.

first-blood.title: First Blood
first-blood.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The column meets the enemy at the ford, sudden and loud and nothing like the drills. This is the part nobody warned you about.

branches.title: Hold the line
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Plant your feet and don't move, whatever comes at you.

success.title: The line holds, and so do you
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The line holds, and you're still standing in it when the enemy breaks.
success.epigraph: PLACEHOLDER: The water ran red, and then it ran clear.

failure.title: The line holds, barely, and it costs you
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: You hold, but you'll be feeling this fight for weeks.

branches.title: Protect Sergeant Harl
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Harl's exposed on the flank. Get to him before something else does.

success.title: He owes you his life
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You get there first, and Harl walks away because you did.

failure.title: You take the blow instead
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: You get there, but not in time to stop the blade meant for him from finding you instead.

branches.title: Break and run
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: This isn't a fight you have to win. It's one you could just leave.

success.title: You get clear
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You get clear of the ford before the worst of it, and nobody who matters sees you go.

failure.title: The rout catches you anyway
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: The rout doesn't care that you tried to leave early. It catches you all the same.

guard-the-stores.title: Guarding the Stores
guard-the-stores.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A tent full of salt pork and a camp full of hungry men.

branches.title: Stand guard
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The hardest part is saying no to your friends.

success.title: Nothing goes missing
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Not one strip of pork walks away on your watch.

failure.title: Something goes missing
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: A sack of oats is gone by morning, and Harl knows whose watch it was.

branches.title: Look the other way
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: A wink, a share of what walks off.

success.title: Friends in the ranks
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You eat well tonight, and the men remember who let them.

harl-rides-out.title: Harl Rides Out
harl-rides-out.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Harl saddles up at first light. Business in the city, he says, and says no more. Nobody will be called forward until he is back.

branches.title: Watch him go
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The camp feels different with him gone. Looser. More dangerous.

success.title: The camp without him
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Two days, the quartermaster reckons. Plenty of time to make a name, or lose one.

haul-sacks.title: Hauling Sacks
haul-sacks.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A grain cart at the gate, and a carter short of backs.

branches.title: Put your back into it
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: A bell of lifting, and a coin for every sack you do not drop.

success.title: Paid in full
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your shoulders ache. Your purse does not.

failure.title: Paid for half
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: A sack splits, and so does your lip. The carter pays you for what arrived.

branches.title: Not today
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your back is worth more than this.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You leave him to it.

hunger-pangs.title: Hunger Pangs
hunger-pangs.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Your stomach won't let you think about much else. There has to be something to eat somewhere nearby.

branches.title: Go looking for something to eat
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Worth the time, surely.

success.title: Something, at least
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Not a feast, but it takes the edge off.

failure.title: Nothing to show for it
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: You come back empty-handed and hungrier for the effort.

irregular.title: A Different Sort of Papers
irregular.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A forger you know owes you a favour, and the quartermaster's staff is always short a pair of hands who can read a ledger and keep their mouth shut.

branches.title: Forge your way into the quartermaster's staff
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The papers are good. You, hopefully, are better.

success.title: Nobody looks twice
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The quartermaster barely glances at you before waving you through to the stores. Easiest work you've ever forged your way into.

failure.title: A close look, but it holds
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: The quartermaster holds your papers up to the light a moment too long. He lets it go, but he'll remember your face.

letter-from-home.title: A Letter From Home
letter-from-home.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A letter finds its way to you through the company's slow, unreliable post. {if [q:levy-path]==1}It's addressed to "the soldier", proud and a little stiff, like they're still not sure what to make of your choice.{else}{if [q:levy-path]==2}It doesn't ask how you're finding army life. It just hopes you're still yourself, whatever that means now.{else}Nobody back home quite believes how you talked your way into this. The letter mostly asks questions you can't answer honestly.{/if}{/if}

branches.title: Read the letter
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: A few coins are folded inside, and a lot of news you already knew.

success.title: News from home
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You read it twice before you let yourself put it away.

make-camp.title: Make Camp
make-camp.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The column halts. Nobody pitches tents on the march. The day ends when you lie down. (You find it when you are tired, or when night falls.)

branches.title: Under a wagon
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The only dry ground for a mile.

success.title: Mud and wheel-spokes
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You wake stiff, wet, and alive.

market-square.title: The Market Square
market-square.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Stalls, mud, shouting. Everyone is talking about the levy and pretending they aren't.

branches.title: Haggle with the traders
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The fishwife's prices are a matter of opinion.

success.title: A fair price, for once
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You talk her down and walk away with more than you came with.

failure.title: Short-changed
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: She talks you up instead. You notice too late.

branches.title: Listen to the talk
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Stand near the well and let the town talk over you.

success.title: War talk
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The clerk with the list drinks at the Boar. The sergeant pays in advance. Useful.

success.title: Nothing worth hearing
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Weather, prices, somebody's cow. Nothing you can use.

mile-after-mile.title: Mile After Mile
mile-after-mile.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The road goes on. So do you.

branches.title: Rain
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: It rains. It stops. It rains.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Wet to the bone, and nobody says a word about it.

branches.title: A marching song
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Somebody starts a song. Somebody else knows the dirty verse.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: For a mile or two, the column is a company.

branches.title: Strange country
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Hills you have never seen, farms with their shutters closed.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The farther you go, the smaller home looks.

muck-out-stables.title: Mucking Out
muck-out-stables.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The ostler at the Boar needs the stalls cleared before the horses come back.

branches.title: Take the shovel
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: It is not glorious. It is paid.

success.title: Clean stalls, dirty hands
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Two coins, and a smell that will follow you until the rain washes it off.

night-falls.title: Night Falls
night-falls.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Compline. The bells stop. Doors are barred, fires banked. Honest folk are abed.

branches.title: Find somewhere to sleep
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The town has beds, for those who can pay, and doorways for those who can't.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: (passes straight through)

branches.title: Go to your bedroll
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your bedroll, your blanket, the snores of the men on either side.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: (passes straight through)

branches.title: Make camp for the night
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The column halts where it halts. You find what shelter there is.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: (passes straight through)

branches.title: Stay up
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Sleep can wait. The night has its own business. Everything you do tonight tires you twice as fast.

success.title: The night is young
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You stay up. The After Dark deck is open, and you can still go to bed at any time.

orders-to-march.title: Orders to March
orders-to-march.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The column forms up at dawn, packs and spears and the sick wagon at the rear. Sergeant Harl walks the line once, checking nothing in particular.

branches.title: Fall in and march
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Shoulder your pack and fall in with the rest.

success.title: The column moves out
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The column lurches into motion, boots on the road, the camp already shrinking behind you.

branches.title: Slip away while you still can
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Nobody's looking. Not yet, anyway.

success.title: You walk, and don't look back
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You peel off from the column at the treeline and don't stop walking until the camp is out of sight.

pass-the-time.title: Pass the Time
pass-the-time.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Nothing presses. You could sit, watch, and let the day go on without you.

branches.title: Let the hours go by
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: A wall to lean on, a crowd to watch.

success.title: Time passes
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: An hour goes by, and nobody needs you for it.

branches.title: Wait for night
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Nothing more for you today. Let the dark come.

success.title: The light goes
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The bells ring through the afternoon, and then it is night.

pressed.title: The List Is Read
pressed.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A clerk reads the list aloud in the square. Your name is on it, plain as anything. Half the town is watching to see what you do.

branches.title: Answer to your name
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: There's no arguing with a royal writ. Best to go with your head up.

success.title: Into the ranks
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You step out of the crowd. Nobody cheers. Somebody has to.

branches.title: Don't answer
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You could just... not be here, for a while.

success.title: You keep your head down
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You melt back into the crowd before the clerk reaches your name a second time. It won't hold forever.

branches.title: Pay your way out
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Coin has bought better men their freedom than this.

success.title: A quiet arrangement
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: A word to the clerk, a heavier purse, and your name is quietly struck from the list.

branches.title: Send someone in your place
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: There are men in this town who'd take your place for the right price, and never ask why.

success.title: Someone else's name
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The coin changes hands in an alley, not the square. Somebody else's name goes to war in yours. You tell yourself it isn't the same as running.

recruiting-sergeant.title: The Recruiting Sergeant
recruiting-sergeant.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A sergeant at a trestle table in the square, a ledger, a purse of the king's coin, and a look that has weighed a thousand men.

branches.title: Ask about the levy
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: How much, how long, and what happens to [danger]men who change their minds[/danger].

success.title: The king's terms
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: He tells you. The pay sounds better than it is. The rest sounds worse.

branches.title: Put your name down
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The ledger is open. The quill is waiting.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: (passes straight through)

sergeant-harl.title: Sergeant Harl
sergeant-harl.intro: PLACEHOLDER: [person]Sergeant Harl[/person]. He runs your section of the camp, and he has not decided about you yet. [q:harl]

branches.title: Run an errand for Sergeant Harl
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Harl needs something carried, delivered, or quietly forgotten about. He doesn't say which.

success.title: Done, and done quietly
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Whatever it was, it's done, and nobody asked questions.

branches.title: Report to the post
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You've made enough of a name for yourself. Time to report to the post like a soldier who matters.

success.title: Called forward
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Harl looks you over one last time and jerks his head toward the punishment post, where something is already happening.

talk-in-the-square.title: Talk in the Square
talk-in-the-square.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The square is never empty and never quiet.

branches.title: Complaints about prices
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Bread is dearer since the levy came. Everything is.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You nod along. Everyone is poorer this year.

branches.title: Talk of the war
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Somebody's cousin saw the enemy's banners, or says he did.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Nobody agrees where the war is. Everybody agrees it is coming closer.

branches.title: A wedding, of sorts
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: A hurried wedding at the chapel door, before the groom's name is read out.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The bride does not cry until the doors close.

the-boar.title: The Boar
the-boar.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The Boar is the only tavern in town, which is why it is still standing. It opens its shutters after None.

branches.title: Drink with the locals
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Ale, bread, the same three songs.

success.title: A warm night
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You eat, you drink, you forget the list for an hour.

branches.title: Stare down the man at the bar
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: There is always one. Tonight he is looking at you.

success.title: He looks away first
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: He finds something interesting in his cup.

failure.title: He doesn't
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: The floor comes up to meet you. The locals step over you on the way out.

the-camp-at-night.title: The Camp at Night
the-camp-at-night.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Fires burn low. The sentries stamp their feet and talk to keep awake.

branches.title: Sit the watch with the sentries
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Nobody asked you to. That's the point.

success.title: A long, cold bell
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The sentries remember who kept them company.

the-camp-gate.title: The Camp Gate
the-camp-gate.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Two sentries, a rope across the road, and the town an hour away.

branches.title: Go into town on liberty
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Liberty from Sext to Vespers, if the sentries are in a good mood.

success.title: The town road
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The town looks different in the king's colours.

the-chapel.title: The Chapel
the-chapel.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Cold stone, a smell of wax, and a priest who has buried half the town.

branches.title: Light a candle
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: For someone, or for yourself.

success.title: A small flame
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: It will burn down long after you have gone. That is the point.

branches.title: Sit in the quiet
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Nobody asks you for anything in here.

success.title: A little rest
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You close your eyes for a moment, and it helps.

the-chaplain.title: The Chaplain
the-chaplain.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The company chaplain walks beside you for a while, saying nothing, which is his way of asking.

branches.title: Tell him what you did
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The ford. The man in the water.

success.title: Heard
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: He listens to the end, and does not say it was all right.

branches.title: Say nothing
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Some things stay yours.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: He nods, and drops back down the column.

the-column.title: The Column
the-column.intro: PLACEHOLDER: Your place in the line of march, your pack, and the back of the man in front.

branches.title: Eat from your pack
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You chew as you walk.

success.title: Hard bread on the march
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your belly stops complaining, for now.

the-fires.title: The Fires
the-fires.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The cook-fires, where the company eats, argues, and waits.

branches.title: Eat with the company
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Pottage, again. You have stopped asking what is in it.

success.title: A bowl of something hot
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Hot, filling, and gone too soon.

branches.title: Sit a while
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Someone is always telling a story here.

success.title: Faces in the firelight
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You learn a few more names, and one or two secrets.

the-ford-ahead.title: The Ford Ahead
the-ford-ahead.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The column comes down out of the hills, and there is the ford, and there is the enemy on the far bank. The company will cross it, one way or another.

branches.title: See to your kit
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Sharpen what can be sharpened. Tighten what can be tightened.

success.title: Edges and straps
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your hands stop shaking once they have something to do.

branches.title: Listen to the veterans
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The old hands have crossed rivers under arrows before.

success.title: What they say about fords
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Keep low, keep moving, never stop in the water. You will remember it.

the-gibbet.title: The Gibbet
the-gibbet.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A cage on a pole at the crossroads, and what is left of a man in it.

branches.title: Look at him
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Somebody's son. A deserter, the placard says.

success.title: You look, and remember
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You make yourself read the placard to the end.

failure.title: You look away
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: The crows look back at you. You walk on quickly.

the-muster.title: The Muster
the-muster.intro: PLACEHOLDER: They line you up in the yard and read the oath from a cracked leather book. A sergeant with cold eyes watches to see who mouths it and who means it.

branches.title: Swear it straight
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Say the words and mean them.

success.title: The words come easily
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The words come easier than you expected. Something in Harl's face loosens, just slightly.
success.epigraph: PLACEHOLDER: The king's coin weighs more than it looks.

branches.title: Mumble your way through it
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Get through it however you can manage.

success.title: Close enough
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Close enough that nobody stops the line for you.

failure.title: Everyone hears you get it wrong
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: You stumble on the third line and half the yard hears it. It doesn't kill you. It does cost you.

branches.title: Refuse the oath
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You didn't ask for this. Say so, and see what happens.

success.title: They flog it out of you
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: They don't argue with you. They just start hitting you, methodically, until the oath comes out of you anyway.

the-post.title: The Post
the-post.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A comrade was caught with his hand in the quartermaster's stores. The whole section is called out to watch him tied to the post, and someone has to swing first.

branches.title: Speak for him
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You could say something in his defence. It might not help.

success.title: They listen, a little
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You get a few words out before the sergeant cuts you off. It's not nothing.

failure.title: Nobody listens
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: Nobody wants to hear it, least of all the officer holding the whip.

branches.title: Say nothing
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Easier to look at your boots and let it happen.

success.title: The cheap way out
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You say nothing. Nobody expected you to.

branches.title: Volunteer to do it yourself
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Someone has to do it. It might as well be someone he trusts to go easy.

success.title: A willing hand
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You take the whip yourself. The ranks watch you do it, and none of them will forget.

the-quartermaster.title: The Quartermaster
the-quartermaster.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A fat man with a ledger, in a tent full of other men's boots. He counts everything twice.

branches.title: Draw your ration
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: What the king gives you, weighed to the ounce.

success.title: Hard bread and salt pork
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: It will keep. That is the best thing about it.

branches.title: Ask for better kit
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Not yet: kit and items come later. He will want coin, or a favour.

success.description: PLACEHOLDER: (never shown)

the-road.title: The Road
the-road.intro: {if [q:the-march] <= 1}PLACEHOLDER: The first day out. The camp is still a smudge behind you, and the road is new under your boots.{else}{if [q:the-march] <= 3}PLACEHOLDER: The column has found its pace. The country is stranger now, and the talk is of the ford.{else}PLACEHOLDER: The ford cannot be far now. Nobody sings. Men look at the hills and not at each other.{/if}{/if} Weather, blisters, and the sick wagon creaking along behind the column.

branches.title: Push on
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Keep walking, and keep the front of the column in sight. That's the whole plan. (Success covers more ground.)

success.title: You make up ground
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You keep the pace, and the column keeps it with you. You cover more ground than anyone reckoned.

failure.title: Your feet give out under you
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your legs go out from under you on a bad stretch of road, and the man behind you doesn't stop in time.

branches.title: Forage off the road
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: There might be something worth eating off the verge, if you know where to look.

success.title: A decent haul
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You come back with more than you left with.

failure.title: Nothing worth carrying back
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: An hour's searching for nothing but brambles and a bad mood.

branches.title: Share your ration
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Someone near you has nothing left. You have a little.

success.title: Nobody goes hungry tonight, not on your watch
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: It's not much, but it's noticed.

the-sick-wagon.title: The Sick Wagon
the-sick-wagon.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A cart at the back of the column, and the men who cannot walk.

branches.title: Help with the sick
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The surgeon's boy cannot do it all.

success.title: Water and a hand
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Some of them will live. They will remember who carried the water.

branches.title: Beg a remedy
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The surgeon's boy sells what the surgeon does not count.

success.title: Something bitter in a cup
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: It tastes like a ditch, and the pain eases.

the-sign-of-the-boar.title: The Sign of the Boar
the-sign-of-the-boar.intro: PLACEHOLDER: A painted boar over a low door: [place]the Boar[/place], shutters closed. A boy sweeping the step says it opens after None, same as always.

branches.title: Remember the place
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Every town has one place where people talk. This is it.

success.title: A place to come back to
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: The Boar is one of your places now. Come back after None.

the-town-after-dark.title: The Town After Dark
the-town-after-dark.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The shutters are down, but not everyone is abed.

branches.title: Walk the streets
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Lanterns in back rooms. Voices that stop when you pass.

success.title: The town's other face
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You find a door that opens for the right word, and leave richer.

failure.title: The watch
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: The night watch doesn't like strangers out after Compline.

the-town-gate.title: The Town Gate
the-town-gate.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The gate the camp road runs out of. The guards know a soldier on liberty when they see one.

branches.title: Back to camp
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: An hour's walk, and Harl counts heads at Compline.

success.title: The camp road
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Mud, then tents, then the smell of the cook-fires.

the-village.title: The Village
the-village.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The order comes down the line, plain and ugly: burn the village, take the grain, leave nothing the enemy can use. Sergeant Harl's face gives away nothing at all.

branches.title: Burn it, and take the grain
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: An order is an order. Are you certain?

success.title: Done, as ordered
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You give the order, and the company does what companies do. The grain is worth more than the guilt, or you tell yourself so.
success.epigraph: PLACEHOLDER: Smoke carries further than screams.

branches.title: Refuse the order
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You won't be the one to give this order, whatever it costs you.

success.title: Not this
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You say no, in front of everyone. Someone else gives the order instead. You watch it happen anyway.

branches.title: Obey, but warn them first
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: There might be a way to see the order carried out and still get word to the village first.

success.title: They're gone before the torches come out
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You slip away long enough to send a boy running ahead. By the time the company arrives, the village is empty and the grain is gone with it.

failure.title: Someone sees you slip away
failure.description: PLACEHOLDER: You get the warning out, but not quietly enough. Someone in the column noticed you were missing.

to-be-continued.title: To Be Continued
to-be-continued.intro:
PLACEHOLDER: This is where the tech demo's slice of the King's Levy ends. The Siege, the Reckoning, the Offer, and the four endings are all still to be written.

[Where you've ended up so far: Crown's Favour [q:crowns-favour], Standing [q:standing].]

branches.title: Onward
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: There is nowhere further to go from here, not yet.

success.title: The rest of the story
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: To be continued.

veterans-tale.title: The Veteran's Tale
veterans-tale.intro: PLACEHOLDER: An old hand starts talking by the fire, the way old hands always do, and everyone within earshot is obliged to listen.

branches.title: The tale of the old war
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: He tells it like he was there for every part of it, which he probably wasn't.

success.title: A war before this one
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You've heard worse stories told better, and better stories told worse.

branches.title: The tale of a lost love
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: This one's quieter than his usual fare, and he tells it looking at the fire instead of his audience.

success.title: Someone he left behind
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Nobody laughs at this one, not even the ones who usually laugh at everything.

branches.title: The tale of the forged papers
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: He claims he once talked his way past three checkpoints with papers he'd written himself, the ink still wet.

success.title: A trick worth remembering
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You file the trick away for later, just in case.

volunteer.title: Take the King's Coin
volunteer.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The recruiting sergeant's table sits in the square, a list of names growing longer by the day. Coin up front, glory promised, a war somewhere over the horizon.

branches.title: Put your name to the muster roll
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: You could do worse than a soldier's pay and a reason to leave this town.

success.title: Sworn in
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Your name goes on the roll. Sergeant Harl looks you over and nods once, like he's already decided something about you.

your-bedroll.title: Your Bedroll
your-bedroll.intro: PLACEHOLDER: The company sleeps in rows. The day ends when you lie down. (You find it when you are tired, or when night falls.)

branches.title: Your own blanket
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: Thin, damp, yours.

success.title: The camp sleeps
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: Reveille comes too soon. It always does.

branches.title: By the fire, with the others
branches.description: PLACEHOLDER: The old hands talk late. Some of it is worth hearing.

success.title: Warm on one side
success.description: PLACEHOLDER: You fall asleep to their voices, and they notice you stayed.

decks.title: The King's Levy
decks.description: Your part in the crown's war, as it happens to you.

closed.reason: PLACEHOLDER: The war sleeps too. It will be waiting in the morning.

decks.quiet: PLACEHOLDER: The war does not need you today.

decks.title: The Town
decks.description: Streets, taverns, and the recruiting table in the square.

closed.reason: PLACEHOLDER: Shutters are down. The town is abed.
PLACEHOLDER: You are too tired to take in the town.

decks.quiet: PLACEHOLDER: The streets are quiet now.

decks.title: The Camp
decks.description: Tents, drill yards, and the sergeants who run them.

closed.reason: PLACEHOLDER: Lights out. Only the sentries are awake.
PLACEHOLDER: You are too tired to care what the camp is up to.

decks.quiet: PLACEHOLDER: The camp has nothing new for you today.

decks.title: The Road
decks.description: Marching, weather, and whatever's waiting at the end of it.

closed.reason: PLACEHOLDER: The column has halted for the night.
PLACEHOLDER: You march with your eyes half shut.

decks.quiet: PLACEHOLDER: Mile after mile, and nothing changes.

decks.title: Fatigues
decks.description: The work that keeps a camp standing, handed out by whoever outranks you.

closed.reason: PLACEHOLDER: The corporals have stopped handing out work.
PLACEHOLDER: Too tired to be any use. The corporal waves you off.

decks.title: Day Labour
decks.description: Honest work for a few coins, while the light lasts.

closed.reason: PLACEHOLDER: The carters have gone home. The work is done for the day.
PLACEHOLDER: Too tired for honest work.

decks.title: Life
decks.description: Small things that happen to you no matter where you are.

closed.reason: PLACEHOLDER: Life can wait until morning.

decks.title: After Dark
decks.description: What goes on while honest people sleep.
decks.quiet: PLACEHOLDER: The night has nothing more for you. Find a bed.

decks.title: Sleep
decks.description: The night. Dealt when you rest; never drawn.

camp.title: The Camp
camp.description: PLACEHOLDER: Rows of tents under a low sky. Mud, smoke, drums at dawn. Everyone here belongs to someone.

road.title: The Road
road.description: PLACEHOLDER: A column of men on a road through bare hills. Rain, blisters, and whatever waits at the end.

town.title: The Town
town.description: PLACEHOLDER: A walled market town on a rise. Wet streets, watchful windows, and the king's list read aloud in the square.

harl-returns.title: Harl returns
harl-returns.message: PLACEHOLDER: Harl is back in camp, and in a mood.

hunger-spiral.title: Hunger spiral
hunger-spiral.message: PLACEHOLDER: Hunger has worn you thin, and thin men break.

pressgang-comes.title: The pressgang
pressgang-comes.message: PLACEHOLDER: The pressgang is at the door.
